newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $33.75 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $33.75 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius said on Thursday it sold 673.5 million rupees ($33.75 million) of treasury bills out of 700 million rupees it tendered this week.

The bank said that at this week's auction, it sold 127.0 million rupees of 91-day, 328.5 million rupees of 182-day and 218.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.99 percent, 10.16 percent and 10.12 percent respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.11 percent per annum from 10.34 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the central bank sold 512.8 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.95 percent, 10.18 percent and 10.10 percent respectively.
